qc.label_under_test: in a reported news or story narrative, the word that tells how an ongoing situation's course runs: it keeps going, ends (often without an outcome), stalls, or is put off or decided ('continuing to', 'now in its third week', 'ended without any trace', 'postponed again', 'has decided to', 'until', 'before'); static facts, market figures, casual first-person plans and instructions ('bake until golden') stay weak; a space-rock headline ('Asteroid Flyby') also fires

neighbours.label: in a reported news story, the word that shows a situation is still unresolved, its outcome pending: still going on or still being searched for, stalled, delayed or put off, or a step announced but not yet carried out ('still searching as night falls', 'pushed back to next month', 'has decided to'); settled outcomes (a verdict reached, ended peacefully, the bill passed), static facts, and first-person plans or recipes stay weak; a space-rock flyby headline ('Asteroid Flyby') also fires
